title: The Ten Vessels of Descent and the Five Gestures of Covenant
description: T8 narrates the ten chariots — vessels by which divine truth descends into the soul, each fitted to the natural's reception: doctrinal carriage, dwelling of the Divine Human, path of regeneration, Call, Answer, the four living elements (air, wind, light, water), and love as the living fire mingled in all the rest. T9 sets out the five gestures — peace, salutation, kiss, right hand, chirotonia — that mark the rational's covenant: how it is sent forth from the inmost into its contest with the self and how it is brought home in the same five mysteries when it returns.
